name: Humboldt University of Berlin
description: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin is a public research university in central Berlin, founded in 1810 on Wilhelm von Humboldt's model of uniting research and teaching. It has around 34,000 students across nine faculties and is funded under Germany's Excellence Strategy as part of the Berlin University Alliance.
whyIncluded: HU Berlin is the coordinating Berlin institution in the Berlin University Alliance's strategic partnership with the National University of Singapore, and Germany is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 640 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: A national average for students in Germany from the German Academic Exchange Service, as the university publishes none. Covers rent, food, transport and personal costs for 12 months; excludes health insurance and fees.
livingCosts.notes: The university publishes no itemised cost-of-living estimate for Berlin, so this is DAAD's 'Average expenses of a German student' (national average, DZHW 22nd Social Survey 2023): rent incl. utilities EUR 410; food EUR 198; transportation EUR 89; personal = recreation/culture/sports 65 + clothing 46 + working materials 31 + telephone/internet/licence 32 + other 144 = EUR 318. Excludes health insurance (100), tuition (76) and semester contribution (36). DAAD is the German Academic Exchange Service, not the university, so marked secondary. DAAD's HU programme entries only give 'approx. 900 to 1,200 EUR' a month without a breakdown; hu-berlin.de blocks automated access.

programmes.name: Informatik B.Sc. (Monobachelor)
programmes.summary: No tuition. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution (administration, student services and a Germany-wide transport ticket), read from a third-party copy of the university's fee details.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees at Humboldt-Universität (Berlin public university). Compulsory fees = semester contribution EUR 355.80 per semester x2: re-registration/administration fee 50 + student body fee 12 (rate from winter 2025/26) + studierendenWERK Berlin 85 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 208.80 (the 2025/26 ticket rate). hu-berlin.de (all subdomains) blocks automated access with an Anubis bot challenge and the Wayback Machine is unreachable from here, so the breakdown is taken from DAAD's International Programmes entry for HU's MEMS master's, hence sourceType secondary. Language of instruction: German. 2024 history: HU's own fee sheet 'Semesterbeiträge und -gebühren Wintersemester 2024/25' (PDF at the sourceUrl of the 2024 row) states EUR 299.90 per semester = semester fee 50 + student body 10.50 + studierendenWERK 63 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 176.40, so EUR 599.80 for 2024; the PDF itself sits behind the Anubis challenge, so the figure was taken from search-engine indexes of that document (two independent queries, same itemisation) and cross-checked against RefRat's semester-ticket pages (EUR 176.40 for 2024) and AMB 09/2025 on edoc.hu-berlin.de (student body fee raised to EUR 12 from winter 2025/26). No 2026/27 figure for HU itself was readable (Charité's sheet for HU-enrolled students gives EUR 381.80).

programmes.name: Medizin (Modellstudiengang, Staatsexamen) at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin
programmes.summary: No tuition. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution charged by Charité, Berlin's joint medical school, for 2026/27. Places are nationally restricted and ranked by grade.
programmes.notes: Medicine in Berlin is taught by Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, the joint medical faculty of Humboldt-Universität and Freie Universität; students enrol at Charité and choose HU or FU for student-body representation. No tuition fees. Compulsory fees = Charité's enrolment (semester) fee for winter semester 2026/27 with HU membership, EUR 381.80 x2 (Charité admissions office sheet, June 2026; the FU variant is EUR 376.80; the sheet does not itemise it). 2025 history: Charité's re-registration sheet for summer semester 2026 (academic year 2025/26) gives EUR 355.80 per semester = student body 12 (raised from winter 2025/26) + studierendenWERK Berlin 85 + administration 50 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 208.80, so EUR 711.60 for 2025. 2024 history: Charité no longer publishes its 2024/25 sheet, so the row uses HU's own fee sheet 'Semesterbeiträge und -gebühren Wintersemester 2024/25' (the HU-membership contribution Charité collects is the same amount): EUR 299.90 per semester = semester fee 50 + student body 10.50 + studierendenWERK 63 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 176.40, so EUR 599.80 for 2024; that PDF sits behind hu-berlin.de's Anubis challenge, so the figure was taken from search-engine indexes of the document (two independent queries, same itemisation) and cross-checked against RefRat's semester-ticket pages (EUR 176.40 for 2024). Undergraduate-entry state examination degree, standard period 12 semesters (DAAD/Hochschulkompass entry for HU medicine); the practical year is included. Admission is nationally restricted; non-EU applicants apply through uni-assist and are ranked by grade. Language of instruction: German. Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications.
